courses.description: Lecture, three hours. Requisites: courses 10, 100A. Limited to juniors/seniors. courses.title: Social Cognitive Neuroscience
courses.description: Lecture, three hours. Principles of social cognitive neuroscience (SCN) and survey of broad array of topics in field. courses.title: Introduction to Health Psychology
courses.description: Lecture, three hours. Requisite: course 10. courses.description: Lecture, three hours. Requisite: course 10. Limited to juniors/seniors. Focus specifically on puberty and sleep, which both lead to consequential effects on behavior, health, and brain development. P/NP or letter grading.
